values.note: $24 a night in the main season (mid-May to Sep 30; the 2026 rate table started Apr 15). From Oct 1 until the road closes in mid-December the sites outside the main gate are free, with no drinking water and unmaintained roads. $2 per pet per night; $6 a night for a second vehicle.

note: Remote Black Hills NF campground in an open meadow along Beaver Creek, right on the WY/SD line and reached from Newcastle, WY: 8 first-come gravel sites, a vault toilet and drinking water in season (no fill hookup). Sites 2, 3 and 5 sit beside the small creek across open grass. Generators 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. Off season the sites outside the gate stay open free, without water, on unmaintained roads. --Claude
